card.name: Extreme dose wording in overdosage sections
card.fires_on: The word "high" in "doses as high as", and nearby words like "large doses", "up to" or the middle of "overdosage". It appears in overdosage and animal toxicity text describing very large amounts.

modes.label: As high as
modes.description: The word "high" in "doses as high as" before a top amount tested or tolerated.

modes.label: Inside overdosage
modes.description: The middle piece of the word overdosage in overdosage section openings.
modes.example: Limited data are available with regard to overd<<os>>age in humans.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about extremes and excess, like absurd, chaos, deliberately and ludicrous.
card.plain: It marks wording that introduces the very large doses given in overdose or animal toxicity sections.
